'''Saban 22 (March 9)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] and his companions travel top [[Shadar Logoth]] where the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]] and the [[Cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']] take place.
*[[1000 NE]] - The use of the [[Choedan Kal]] is sensed by every channeler around the world.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mat]]'s party departs from [[Ebou Dar]] with [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]]'s forces finally catch up to the [[Shaido]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Elayne]] bargains with the [[Sea Folk]] for the [[Windfinder]]s' continued aid in [[Caemlyn]].
*[[1000 NE]] - Four young high-seats of [[Andor]] are brought to Elayne to declare their support for her throne.
